A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TAK research work and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–G. No material gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original vision and language task-arithmetic experiments, task-negation results, and ablation, robustness, and compression studies in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical evaluations in Section 4 and the appendices, including TAK benchmark results and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The linearized model, GGN/KFAC regularizer, and factor-aggregation procedure in Algorithms 1–2 and Equations 1–8 are unchanged. The universal-KFAC and compression variants also already appear in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight vision datasets, six NLI tasks, ImageNet control/reference data, and additional class-partitioned vision scenarios in Appendix F.7. Relabeling radar axes does not add or remove dataset coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including diagonal GGN, τJp, TaLoS, attention-only fine-tuning, and the TIES, TSV, and ISO merging comparisons.

E3.justification: The model configurations, training settings, accuracy metrics, coefficient sweeps, task-negation control criterion, and class-partition evaluation procedures are retained. Appendix text crossing different page boundaries does not change these settings.

E4.justification: The coefficient ablations, curvature-estimation studies, universal-KFAC experiment, task-localization analyses, and compression tests are unchanged. Figure 11 and Table 5 move without introducing new analyses.

E5.justification: Table 5 retains the same three seeds, 7, 21, and 42, and the same uncertainty entries. The uncertainty displays and discussion accompanying Figure 7 are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Figures 2 and 10 retain their plotted curve values but reassign six dataset labels: for example, the top axis changes from Cars to EuroSAT and the bottom axis from MNIST to SUN397. This changes dataset-specific accuracy attributions. Tabulated scores and other reported results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The representation-drift derivation, GGN/KFAC mathematics, and Appendix C derivation and approximation-error bound are unchanged, as is the disentanglement-error definition in Appendix D.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about dataless regularization, constant complexity across tasks, improved disentanglement, and robustness to task-vector scaling.

C2.justification: The interpretations of regularization, model scale, task localization, and compression are retained. Appendix B's limitations and Appendix F.4's qualification about requiring task-specific curvature statistics are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix E's implementation settings, Appendix F.6's compression instructions, and the Mammoth code-availability statement are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including Appendix G. Reference entries that cross page boundaries remain present in both versions.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short acknowledgment of Symboolic s.r.l. for funding Thomas Sommariva's PhD position and Lorenzo Bonicelli's contribution. Scientific prose and section ordering otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 10 have revised dataset-axis labels and slight sizing adjustments. Figure 11 moves from page 20 to 21, Table 5 moves from page 21 to 22, and surrounding appendix and reference material reflows.

improvement.justification: The potentially meaningful revision is the dataset-label reassignment in Figures 2 and 10. Neither PDF explains it or supplies corroborating per-task values under matching settings to establish whether it fixes or introduces attribution errors. Other scientific content is unchanged, and the acknowledgment and layout edits do not establish a clear overall quality gain or loss.
